remarks: SONO 2 bedroom 1.5 bath Duplex Townhouse 1 block over from Washington Street in vibrant downtown SONO!, come enjoy the neighborhood...this Charming Victorian apartment, has been totally renovated. Entire apartment has been freshly painted, 2 reserved off street parking spots. Walk to shopping, movies, new Mall and restaurants... close to all SONO has to offer. 2 block to train for commuters. A MUST SEE!
